Done. Submitting iteration 8.

**What changed this iteration**
- Rebuilt the image-analysis toolchain in `/tmp` (venv wiped again) and rigorously decoded `design/references/shows_genres_menu.jpg`: the genre page hero has a red "GENRES" eyebrow (≈24px, 3.6vw, ~45vh) above a large white genre title (~93px cap, x-height mix = title case), and — found via component scanning — a white **Play** button (156×57px) + **More Info** icon at ~63–68vh that my earlier design was missing. The "second line" I kept seeing was a bright horizon line in the backdrop, not text.
- Reworked `app/frontend/src/pages/GenreCategory.jsx`: hero now 73vh (matches the reference's ~786px), red `GENRES` eyebrow + adaptive title size (6.7vw for ≤12-char names, 4vw for longer ones so they stay one line), and wired Play/More Info buttons (`/watch/:id`, title modal). Grid cards gained a red **TOP 10** rank badge (top-right, real `top10_rank` data) and a red **NEW** pill (bottom-center, 4 most-recent titles by year) matching the reference's red card badges.
- Verified `top10_rank` is serialized by the API; frontend builds clean; final state cleaned (`node_modules`/`dist` removed).

**Validation** (3 runs this iteration, all identical): `api_smoke` PASSED 14/14, 13/15 contract 2xx (the 2 non-2xx are intentional: empty-body `POST /api/my-list` → 422, non-owned `DELETE /api/my-list/1` → 404), 8/8 business chain, 25 pages/16 routes, no dead controls.

**Still missing/uncertain**
- `design/references/genre_category.jpg` shows a genre-hero variant with a **red** title (no visible white title); I implemented the `shows_genres_menu` variant (white title + red eyebrow) since that one decoded cleanly — the two can't both be true for one template.
- Two small undecoded elements in `shows_genres_menu.jpg` (a ~22px white glyph cluster left of the title, a 300×22 white bar bottom-left) were left out rather than risk fabricating UI.
